messages:
arjun: Heads-up: preflight for add_user_index_v2 in ~30m. Need to confirm lease/lock window.

deploybot: Deployment scheduled by @arjun: add_user_index_v2 on prod at 2026-03-01T22:00Z. Canary until 22:15Z. Holdpoint: canary healthy + no >10s rowlocks.

olivia: Noted. Updating release notes and changelog. Will also add rollback steps.

sam: Quick Q: are we pinning tenant-mapper service to schema v4 for this roll? If not, we should.

arjun: Yes pinning required. Running: `./scripts/pin-schema.sh tenant-mapper v4`

arjun: ```
# pin command for ops CI
./scripts/pin-schema.sh tenant-mapper v4 
# verify
./scripts/check-pins.sh tenant-mapper
```

katie: mig-watch: watching lock duration, will alert if > 120s per shard.

mig-watch-bot: mig-watch: observed avg lock 48s in staging; no stalls. :thumbsup:

olivia: Release notes: added note about index creation method (concurrent) and backfill strategy. I'll attach the docs after deploy.

deploybot: Holdpoint: canary check required. Trigger with `/deploybot canary-check 6350012345`

sam: If canary fails, rollback plan A: cancel remaining shards and drop new index on canary nodes. Plan B: full rollback and pin service to previous schema commit.

arjun: Agree. For emergency rollback: `./ops/rollback_index.sh add_user_index_v2 --force`

olivia: Pushing release notes to the release branch and tagging. PR: https://git.company/release/12345

katie: I'll stand by on paging for <@oncall-db> during the quiet window. ETA 22:00Z.

deploybot: canary passed at 22:12Z — no elevated locks. Continuing to full rollout in 5m. :rocket:

arjun: Start full rollout. Monitoring KV cache and replication lag.

mig-watch-bot: Alert: Replica lag spike to 3s on shard-7 at 22:18Z, normalized 22:20Z.

sam: Confirmed no user-facing errors. Rollout continues. Will update release notes with metrics.

olivia: Done — release notes updated with token for rollback steps and owner contacts.

arjun: Closing thread. Postmortem only if rollback triggered.
